    ## 7. Financial invariants (critical tests)
    
    1. For every valid expense, `sum(payers.amountCents) === amountCents`.
    2. For every valid expense, `sum(participants.amountCents) === amountCents`.
    3. With only open expenses, `sum(all member net balances) === 0`.
    4. Total debts in a simplified transfer list equal total outstanding credits, in cents.
    5. Reopening the same settled expense restores exactly the previously excluded balances.
    6. Equal split of **100 cents across 3 people** yields `{34, 33, 33}` in deterministic order.
    7. Payer and participant roles may overlap or differ; a member's net can be positive, negative or zero.
    8. An expense with two payers contributing 3,000 and 1,500 cents, split equally among three, gives payer nets +1,500 and 0; third person's net -1,500.
    
    ## 8. Interface screens
    
    - **Welcome:** Choose sample vs empty. Empty asks household name, currency and 2–5 roommates.
    - **Dashboard:** Household title, current-profile switcher, personal summary cards, upcoming chores, concise household overview.
    - **Chores:** List/Kanban toggle, filter controls, add/edit modal or sheet, details/history, status buttons, rotation.
    - **Expenses:** Household balances, expense list, add/edit form with payer + participant builders and split-method tabs, settlement confirmation and breakdown.
    - **Agreements:** Clean document-like list of editable titles/details.
    - **Settings:** Name, currency, roster with avatars, archive/restore, sample reset and start over.
    
    ## 9. Demo data contract
    
    Sample mode should be convincing, not random. Example household: **Maple House**, currency **CAD**, with Avery, Jordan and Sam. Seed:
    - Pending chores (including one overdue relative to current local date), one completed chore with a completion event, and one skipped chore.
    - Several expenses in different categories, at least one with two payers and one using a non-equal split; keep all amounts internally consistent.
    - Both Open and Settled expenses so the balance calculation and settlement functionality can be demonstrated.
    - Quiet hours, cleaning supplies and guest etiquette agreements.
    
    Seed due dates **relative to first-run local date** so the demo doesn't become stale. Seed data only upon selection or explicit reset; do not regenerate it on each render or refresh.

    }: InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & {
      id: string;

    }) {
      const descriptions =
        [help && `${id}-help`, error && `${id}-error`, props["aria-describedby"]]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(" ") || undefined;
      return (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label htmlFor={id} className="block text-sm font-medium">
            {label}
            {props.required && <span className="text-muted"> (required)</span>}
          </label>
          <input
            {...props}
            id={id}
            className={`${controlStyles} ${props.className ?? ""}`}
            aria-invalid={error ? true : props["aria-invalid"]}
            aria-describedby={descriptions}
          />
          {help && (
            <p id={`${id}-help`} className="text-sm text-muted">
              {help}
            </p>
          )}
          {error && (
            <p id={`${id}-error`} className="text-sm text-danger">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

        .split(/\s+/u)

          className={`inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-subtle font-semibold text-muted ${size === "sm" ? "size-8 text-xs" : "size-11 text-sm"}`}

          <span aria-hidden="true">

          </span>
        </span>

    export function isCalendarDate(value: string): boolean {
      if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return false;
      const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
      if (year < 1 || month < 1 || month > 12) return false;
      const leap = year % 4 === 0 && (year % 100 !== 0 || year % 400 === 0);
      const days = [31, leap ? 29 : 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31];
      return day >= 1 && day <= days[month - 1];
    }
    
    export function localDate(date: Date): string {
      return `${String(date.getFullYear()).padStart(4, "0")}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }
    
    export function relativeDate(now: Date, days: number): string {
      const date = new Date(now);
      date.setHours(12, 0, 0, 0);
      date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);
      return localDate(date);
    }
    
    export function displayDate(value: string): string {
      const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
      const date = new Date(0);
      date.setFullYear(year, month - 1, day);
      date.setHours(12, 0, 0, 0);
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }).format(date);
    }

    export function archiveBlockReason(state: AppState, id: string): string | null {
      if (activeMembers(state).length <= 2) return "At least two active roommates must remain.";
      const chores = state.chores.some((chore) => chore.assigneeId === id && chore.status === "pending");
      const expenses = state.expenses.some((expense) => expense.status === "open" && [...expense.payers, ...expense.participants].some((row) => row.memberId === id));
      if (chores && expenses) return "Reassign this roommate's pending chores and settle their open expenses first.";
      if (chores) return "Reassign this roommate's pending chores first.";
      if (expenses) return "Settle this roommate's open expenses first.";
      return null;
    }
    
    export function createEmptyHousehold(input: SetupInput, makeId: () => string): AppState {
      const clean = setupSchema.parse({ ...input, name: input.name.trim(), members: input.members.map((member) => ({ ...member, name: member.name.trim() })) });
      const members = clean.members.map((member, order) => ({ ...member, id: makeId(), active: true, order }));
      return validateState({ schemaVersion: 1, household: { name: clean.name, currency: clean.currency }, members, selectedMemberId: members[0].id, chores: [], expenses: [], agreements: [], starterMode: "empty" });
    }
    
    export function applyHouseholdAction(state: AppState, action: HouseholdAction, makeId: () => string): AppState {
      let next: AppState;
      if (action.type === "update-household") {
        const household = householdDraftSchema.parse({ name: action.name.trim(), currency: action.currency });
        if (household.currency !== state.household.currency && state.expenses.length > 0) throw new Error("Remove all expenses, including settled expenses, before changing currency.");
        next = { ...state, household };
      } else if (action.type === "add-member") {
        if (activeMembers(state).length >= 5) throw new Error("A household can have at most five active roommates.");
        const member = memberDraftSchema.parse({ ...action.member, name: action.member.name.trim() });
        next = { ...state, members: [...state.members, { ...member, id: makeId(), active: true, order: Math.max(...state.members.map((item) => item.order)) + 1 }] };
      } else {
        const member = state.members.find((item) => item.id === action.id);
        if (!member) throw new Error("This roommate could not be found. Reload the household and try again.");
        if (action.type === "select-member") {
          if (!member.active) throw new Error("Choose an active roommate.");
          next = { ...state, selectedMemberId: member.id };
        } else if (action.type === "edit-member") {
          const changes = memberDraftSchema.parse({ ...action.member, name: action.member.name.trim() });
          next = { ...state, members: state.members.map((item) => item.id === member.id ? { ...item, ...changes } : item) };
        } else {
          const active = action.type === "restore-member";
          if (member.active === active) return state;
          if (active && activeMembers(state).length >= 5) throw new Error("Archive another roommate before restoring this one. The active limit is five.");
          if (!active) {
            const reason = archiveBlockReason(state, member.id);
            if (reason) throw new Error(reason);
          }
          next = { ...state, members: state.members.map((item) => item.id === member.id ? { ...item, active } : item) };
        }
      }
      return validateState(next);
    }

    import { z } from "zod";
    import { isCalendarDate } from "./dates";
    import type { AppState } from "./types";
    
    export const currencies = ["CAD", "USD", "EUR", "GBP"] as const;
    export const avatarIcons = ["🌿", "☀️", "🌙", "🍊", "🌸", "🏡"] as const;
    const id = z.string().min(1).max(100);
    const text = (max: number) => z.string().min(1).max(max).refine((value) => value === value.trim(), "Remove spaces at the beginning or end.");
    const cents = z.number().int().nonnegative().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
    const calendarDate = z.string().refine(isCalendarDate, "Choose a valid calendar date.");
    const timestamp = z.iso.datetime({ offset: true });
    
    export const avatarSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
      z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("initials"), value: z.literal("") }),
      z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("icon"), value: z.enum(avatarIcons) }),
      z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("image"), value: z.string().max(100_000).regex(/^data:image\/(png|jpeg|webp);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/) }),
    ]);
    export const memberDraftSchema = z.strictObject({ name: text(40), avatar: avatarSchema });
    export const householdDraftSchema = z.strictObject({ name: text(60), currency: z.enum(currencies) });
    export const setupSchema = householdDraftSchema.extend({ members: z.array(memberDraftSchema).min(2).max(5) });
    
    const stateSchema = z.strictObject({
      schemaVersion: z.literal(1),
      household: householdDraftSchema,
      members: z.array(memberDraftSchema.extend({ id, active: z.boolean(), order: z.number().int().nonnegative().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1) })),
      selectedMemberId: id,
      chores: z.array(z.strictObject({ id, title: text(100), notes: z.string().max(1000), assigneeId: id, dueDate: calendarDate, status: z.enum(["pending", "completed", "skipped"]), completionHistory: z.array(z.strictObject({ id, completedById: id, completedAt: timestamp })), createdAt: timestamp })),
      expenses: z.array(z.strictObject({ id, description: text(100), amountCents: cents.positive(), date: calendarDate, category: text(50), notes: z.string().max(1000), payers: z.array(z.strictObject({ memberId: id, amountCents: cents.positive() })).min(1), participants: z.array(z.strictObject({ memberId: id, amountCents: cents })).min(1), splitMethod: z.enum(["equal", "percentage", "fixed"]), percentageBasisPoints: z.record(id, z.number().int().min(0).max(10000)).optional(), status: z.enum(["open", "settled"]), createdAt: timestamp })),
      agreements: z.array(z.strictObject({ id, title: text(100), details: z.string().max(1000) })),
      starterMode: z.enum(["sample", "empty"]),
    }).superRefine((state, ctx) => {
      const issue = (message: string) => ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message });
      const unique = (values: (string | number)[]) => new Set(values).size === values.length;
      const members = new Map(state.members.map((member) => [member.id, member]));
      const active = state.members.filter((member) => member.active);
      if (active.length < 2 || active.length > 5) issue("A household needs 2–5 active roommates.");
      if (!unique(state.members.map((member) => member.id)) || !unique(state.members.map((member) => member.order))) issue("Roommate identities and roster positions must be unique.");
      if (!members.has(state.selectedMemberId)) issue("The selected roommate does not exist.");
      for (const collection of [state.chores, state.expenses, state.agreements]) {
        if (!unique(collection.map((item) => item.id))) issue("Record identities must be unique.");
      }
      const events = state.chores.flatMap((chore) => chore.completionHistory);
      if (!unique(events.map((event) => event.id))) issue("Completion identities must be unique.");
      for (const chore of state.chores) {
        if (!members.has(chore.assigneeId) || (chore.status === "pending" && !members.get(chore.assigneeId)?.active)) issue("Pending chores must be assigned to active roommates.");
        if (chore.status === "completed" && chore.completionHistory.length === 0) issue("Completed chores need a completion event.");
        if (chore.completionHistory.some((event) => !members.has(event.completedById))) issue("Completion history references a missing roommate.");
      }
      for (const expense of state.expenses) {
        const all = [...expense.payers, ...expense.participants];
        if (all.some((row) => !members.has(row.memberId) || (expense.status === "open" && !members.get(row.memberId)?.active))) issue("Open expenses must reference active roommates.");
        for (const rows of [expense.payers, expense.participants]) {
          if (!unique(rows.map((row) => row.memberId))) issue("A roommate may occur only once in each expense role.");
          if (rows.reduce((total, row) => total + BigInt(row.amountCents), 0n) !== BigInt(expense.amountCents)) issue("Expense contributions and shares must each equal the total.");
        }
        if (expense.splitMethod !== "percentage" && expense.percentageBasisPoints !== undefined) issue("Only percentage splits may have percentage weights.");
        if (expense.splitMethod === "fixed") continue;
        const participants = [...expense.participants].sort((a, b) => (members.get(a.memberId)?.order ?? 0) - (members.get(b.memberId)?.order ?? 0));
        const weights = expense.percentageBasisPoints;
        if (expense.splitMethod === "percentage" && (!weights || Object.keys(weights).length !== participants.length || participants.some((row) => weights[row.memberId] === undefined) || Object.values(weights).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) !== 10000)) {
          issue("Percentages must match the participants and total 100.00%.");
          continue;
        }
        // BigInt protects validation of large saved amounts from unsafe intermediate products.
        const divisor = BigInt(expense.splitMethod === "equal" ? participants.length : 10000);
        const allocations = participants.map((row, index) => {
          const product = BigInt(expense.amountCents) * BigInt(expense.splitMethod === "equal" ? 1 : weights![row.memberId]);
          return { row, index, amount: product / divisor, remainder: product % divisor };
        });
        const remaining = Number(BigInt(expense.amountCents) - allocations.reduce((total, allocation) => total + allocation.amount, 0n));
        const ranked = [...allocations].sort((a, b) => a.remainder === b.remainder ? a.index - b.index : a.remainder > b.remainder ? -1 : 1);
        ranked.slice(0, remaining).forEach((allocation) => { allocation.amount += 1n; });
        if (allocations.some((allocation) => BigInt(allocation.row.amountCents) !== allocation.amount)) issue("Saved shares do not match the chosen split.");
      }
    });
    
    export function validateState(value: unknown): AppState {
      const state = stateSchema.parse(value);
      if (!state.members.find((member) => member.id === state.selectedMemberId)?.active) {
        state.selectedMemberId = [...state.members].filter((member) => member.active).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)[0].id;
      }
      return state;
    }

    "use client";
    
    import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useSyncExternalStore, type ReactNode } from "react";
    import { createHouseholdStore, initialSnapshot, STORAGE_KEY, type HouseholdStore } from "./household-store";
    
    const HouseholdContext = createContext<HouseholdStore | null>(null);
    
    export function HouseholdProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
      const [store] = useState(() => createHouseholdStore(() => window.localStorage));
      useEffect(() => {
        store.initialize();
        const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
          if (event.key === STORAGE_KEY || event.key === null) store.checkForExternalChange();
        };
        const onFocus = () => store.checkForExternalChange();
        window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
        window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
        return () => { window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage); window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus); };
      }, [store]);
      return <HouseholdContext.Provider value={store}>{children}</HouseholdContext.Provider>;
    }
    
    export function useHousehold() {
      const store = useContext(HouseholdContext);
      if (!store) throw new Error("HouseholdProvider is missing.");
      const snapshot = useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.getSnapshot, () => initialSnapshot);
      return { ...snapshot, store };
    }
    
    export function useReadyHousehold() {
      const household = useHousehold();
      if (!household.state) throw new Error("This view requires a loaded household.");
      return { ...household, state: household.state };
    }

    import { ZodError } from "zod";
    import { applyHouseholdAction, createEmptyHousehold, type HouseholdAction, type SetupInput } from "../domain/household";
    import { createSampleHousehold } from "../domain/sample";
    import { validateState } from "../domain/validation";
    import type { AppState, Currency } from "../domain/types";
    
    export const STORAGE_KEY = "roomieos:v1";
    export type StoragePort = Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "setItem" | "removeItem">;
    export type CommandResult = { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string };
    export type HouseholdSnapshot = {
      status: "loading" | "empty" | "ready" | "invalid" | "unavailable";
      state: AppState | null;
      error: string | null;
      conflict: boolean;
      notice: string | null;
    };
    export const initialSnapshot: HouseholdSnapshot = { status: "loading", state: null, error: null, conflict: false, notice: null };
    
    export function createHouseholdStore(getStorage: () => StoragePort, makeId = () => crypto.randomUUID(), now = () => new Date()) {
      let snapshot = initialSnapshot;
      let lastRaw: string | null = null;
      const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
      const publish = (changes: Partial<HouseholdSnapshot>) => {
        snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...changes };
        listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
      };
      const failure = (message: string): CommandResult => {
        publish({ error: message, notice: null });
        return { ok: false, error: message };
      };
      const messageFor = (error: unknown) => error instanceof ZodError ? error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Check the form and try again." : error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The change could not be saved. Try again.";
    
      function initialize() {
        let raw: string | null;
        try { raw = getStorage().getItem(STORAGE_KEY); }
        catch {
          publish({ status: "unavailable", state: null, error: "Browser storage is unavailable. Allow site storage and try again. Your saved data has not been replaced.", conflict: false, notice: null });
          return;
        }
        lastRaw = raw;
        if (raw === null) {
          publish({ status: "empty", state: null, error: null, conflict: false, notice: null });
          return;
        }
        try {
          const state = validateState(JSON.parse(raw));
          publish({ status: "ready", state, error: null, conflict: false, notice: null });
        } catch {
          publish({ status: "invalid", state: null, error: "Saved data couldn't be opened. It may be damaged or from an unsupported version. Nothing has been overwritten.", conflict: false, notice: null });
        }
      }
    
      function checkCurrent(storage: StoragePort) {
        if (snapshot.conflict || storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) !== lastRaw) {
          publish({ conflict: true });
          throw new Error("This household changed in another tab. Reload the saved household before making more changes.");
        }
      }
    
      function write(next: AppState, notice: string): CommandResult {
        let state: AppState;
        try { state = validateState(next); }
        catch (error) { return failure(messageFor(error)); }
        let storage: StoragePort;
        try {
          storage = getStorage();
          checkCurrent(storage);
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(snapshot.conflict ? messageFor(error) : "Couldn't access browser storage. Your change has not been saved. Allow site storage and retry.");
        }
        const raw = JSON.stringify(state);
        try { storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, raw); }
        catch { return failure("Couldn't save changes. Browser storage may be full or blocked. Your previous household and form entries are unchanged. Free some space or allow site storage, then retry."); }
        lastRaw = raw;
        publish({ status: "ready", state, error: null, notice, conflict: false });
        return { ok: true };
      }
    
      function dispatch(action: HouseholdAction, notice: string): CommandResult {
        if (snapshot.status !== "ready" || !snapshot.state) return failure("Open a valid household before making changes.");
        try { return write(applyHouseholdAction(snapshot.state, action, makeId), notice); }
        catch (error) { return failure(messageFor(error)); }
      }
    
      function setup(input: SetupInput): CommandResult {
        if (snapshot.status !== "empty") return failure("A saved household already exists. Open it or use Start over in Settings.");
        try { return write(createEmptyHousehold(input, makeId), "Your household is ready."); }
        catch (error) { return failure(messageFor(error)); }
      }
    
      function sample(currency: Currency, reset = false): CommandResult {
        if ((!reset && snapshot.status !== "empty") || (reset && snapshot.status !== "ready")) return failure("Open the household before resetting, or start from the welcome screen.");
        return write(createSampleHousehold(now(), currency), reset ? "Sample household restored." : "Welcome to Maple House.");
      }
    
      function clear(): CommandResult {
        if (snapshot.status !== "ready" && snapshot.status !== "invalid") return failure("No household is available to clear.");
        try {
          const storage = getStorage();
          checkCurrent(storage);
          storage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        } catch (error) {
          return failure(snapshot.conflict ? messageFor(error) : "Couldn't clear saved data. Allow browser storage and try again. Your household has been kept.");
        }
        lastRaw = null;
        publish({ status: "empty", state: null, error: null, conflict: false, notice: "Saved household cleared." });
        return { ok: true };
      }
    
      function checkForExternalChange() {
        if (snapshot.status === "loading" || snapshot.status === "unavailable") return;
        try {
          if (getStorage().getItem(STORAGE_KEY) !== lastRaw) publish({ conflict: true, notice: null });
        } catch {
          publish({ error: "Couldn't check browser storage. Saving will verify it again before applying any change.", notice: null });
        }
      }
    
      return {
        getSnapshot: () => snapshot,
        subscribe: (listener: () => void) => { listeners.add(listener); return () => { listeners.delete(listener); }; },
        initialize, dispatch, setup, sample, clear, checkForExternalChange,
        dismissFeedback: () => publish({ error: null, notice: null }),
      };
    }
    
    export type HouseholdStore = ReturnType<typeof createHouseholdStore>;

    export function CurrencyField({ value, onChange, disabled = false, id = "currency" }: { value: Currency; onChange: (value: Currency) => void; disabled?: boolean; id?: string }) {
      return <SelectField id={id} label="Household currency" value={value} disabled={disabled} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value as Currency)}>{currencies.map((currency) => <option key={currency} value={currency}>{currency}</option>)}</SelectField>;
    }
    
    export function AvatarField({ id, label = "Avatar", avatar, onChange }: { id: string; label?: string; avatar: Member["avatar"]; onChange: (avatar: Member["avatar"]) => void }) {
      return <SelectField id={id} label={label} value={avatar.kind === "icon" ? avatar.value : "initials"} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value === "initials" ? { kind: "initials", value: "" } : { kind: "icon", value: event.target.value })}><option value="initials">Initials</option>{avatarIcons.map((icon) => <option key={icon} value={icon}>{icon}</option>)}</SelectField>;
    }
    
    export function focusInvalid(form: HTMLFormElement) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => form.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-invalid="true"]')?.focus());

    import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
    import { createHouseholdStore, STORAGE_KEY, type StoragePort } from "./household-store";
    import { createSampleHousehold } from "../domain/sample";
    
    const now = new Date(2026, 10, 23, 12);
    function harness(initial: string | null = null) {
      let raw = initial;
      let failRead = false, failWrite = false, failClear = false;
      let writes = 0;
      const storage: StoragePort = {
        getItem: () => { if (failRead) throw new Error("blocked"); return raw; },
        setItem: (_key, value) => { if (failWrite) throw new Error("quota"); raw = value; writes++; },
        removeItem: () => { if (failClear) throw new Error("blocked"); raw = null; },
      };
      const store = createHouseholdStore(() => storage, () => "generated", () => now);
      return { store, storage, raw: () => raw, writes: () => writes, external: (value: string | null) => { raw = value; }, failReads: (value: boolean) => { failRead = value; }, failWrites: (value: boolean) => { failWrite = value; }, failClears: (value: boolean) => { failClear = value; } };
    }
    
    describe("browser persistence transaction", () => {
      it("does not seed or write during initialization, including repeated initialization", () => {
        const h = harness();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("loading");
        h.store.initialize(); h.store.initialize();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("empty");
        expect(h.raw()).toBeNull(); expect(h.writes()).toBe(0);
        expect(h.store.sample("USD").ok).toBe(true);
        const saved = h.raw();
        h.store.initialize();
        expect(h.raw()).toBe(saved);
        expect(h.writes()).toBe(1);
      });
      it("persists before notifying subscribers and retains all modified facts after refresh", () => {
        const h = harness(); h.store.initialize(); h.store.sample("EUR");
        const savedFacts = h.store.getSnapshot().state!;
        const unsubscribe = h.store.subscribe(() => {
          const snapshot = h.store.getSnapshot();
          if (snapshot.state?.household.name === "New name") expect(JSON.parse(h.raw()!).household.name).toBe("New name");
        });
        h.store.dispatch({ type: "update-household", name: "New name", currency: "EUR" }, "Saved");
        h.store.dispatch({ type: "select-member", id: "jordan" }, "Switched");
        unsubscribe();
        const refreshed = createHouseholdStore(() => h.storage);
        refreshed.initialize();
        expect(refreshed.getSnapshot().state).toEqual({ ...savedFacts, household: { name: "New name", currency: "EUR" }, selectedMemberId: "jordan" });
      });
      it.each(["{bad json", JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 99 }), "null", ""])("keeps invalid data untouched until an explicit clear (%s)", (raw) => {
        const h = harness(raw); h.store.initialize();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("invalid");
        expect(h.store.sample("CAD").ok).toBe(false);
        expect(h.raw()).toBe(raw); expect(h.writes()).toBe(0);
        expect(h.store.clear().ok).toBe(true);
        expect(h.raw()).toBeNull(); expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("empty");
      });
      it("supports retry after storage reads are blocked", () => {
        const h = harness(); h.failReads(true); h.store.initialize();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("unavailable");
        h.failReads(false); h.store.initialize();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("empty");
      });
      it("does not publish failed writes or show a successful save", () => {
        const h = harness(); h.store.initialize(); h.store.sample("CAD");
        const previous = h.store.getSnapshot().state;
        const raw = h.raw(); h.failWrites(true);
        const result = h.store.dispatch({ type: "edit-member", id: "avery", member: { name: "Changed", avatar: { kind: "initials", value: "" } } }, "Saved");
        expect(result.ok).toBe(false);
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().state).toBe(previous);
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().notice).toBeNull();
        expect(h.raw()).toBe(raw);
        h.failWrites(false);
        expect(h.store.dispatch({ type: "select-member", id: "jordan" }, "Switched").ok).toBe(true);
      });
      it("retains the household on failed start-over and reset writes", () => {
        const h = harness(); h.store.initialize(); h.store.sample("CAD");
        const raw = h.raw();
        h.failClears(true); expect(h.store.clear().ok).toBe(false); expect(h.raw()).toBe(raw);
        h.failWrites(true); expect(h.store.sample("CAD", true).ok).toBe(false); expect(h.raw()).toBe(raw);
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().status).toBe("ready");
      });
      it("blocks stale writes even before a storage event is delivered", () => {
        const h = harness(); h.store.initialize(); h.store.sample("CAD");
        const external = JSON.stringify({ ...createSampleHousehold(now), household: { name: "Another tab", currency: "CAD" } });
        h.external(external);
        expect(h.store.dispatch({ type: "select-member", id: "jordan" }, "Switched").ok).toBe(false);
        expect(h.raw()).toBe(external); expect(h.store.getSnapshot().conflict).toBe(true);
        expect(h.store.clear().ok).toBe(false);
        h.store.initialize();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().state?.household.name).toBe("Another tab");
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().conflict).toBe(false);
      });
      it("detects external removal and does not resurrect the household", () => {
        const h = harness(); h.store.initialize(); h.store.sample("CAD");
        h.external(null); h.store.checkForExternalChange();
        expect(h.store.getSnapshot().conflict).toBe(true);
        expect(h.store.sample("CAD", true).ok).toBe(false);
        expect(h.raw()).toBeNull();
      });
      it("uses the documented storage key", () => { expect(STORAGE_KEY).toBe("roomieos:v1"); });
    });

    "use client";
    
    import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
    import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
    import { House } from "lucide-react";
    import { useHousehold } from "./household-provider";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { Wordmark } from "@/components/wordmark";
    
    export function HouseholdGate({
      children,
      welcome = false,
    }: {
      children: ReactNode;
      welcome?: boolean;
    }) {
      const { status, conflict, error, store } = useHousehold();
      const router = useRouter();
      const pathname = usePathname();
      const [confirmReset, setConfirmReset] = useState(false);
      const needsSetup = status === "empty" && !welcome;
      const hasHousehold = status === "ready" && welcome;
      useEffect(() => {
        if (needsSetup) router.replace("/welcome");
        if (hasHousehold) router.replace("/");
      }, [needsSetup, hasHousehold, router, pathname]);
    
      if (status === "loading" || needsSetup || hasHousehold)
        return (
          <main
            className="flex min-h-dvh items-center justify-center gap-3 px-5 text-sm text-muted"
            aria-busy="true"
          >
            <House aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" />
            <p>Opening your household…</p>
          </main>
        );
      if (status === "invalid" || status === "unavailable") {
        return (
          <main className="mx-auto flex min-h-dvh max-w-lg flex-col justify-center px-5 py-10">
            <div className="mb-10">
              <Wordmark />
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">
              {status === "invalid"
                ? "Saved data couldn't be opened"
                : "Browser storage is unavailable"}
            </h1>
            <div className="mt-5">
              <InlineNotice tone="error">{error}</InlineNotice>
            </div>
            {conflict && (
              <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-warning">
                Saved data changed in another tab. Retry before resetting.
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => store.initialize()}>
                Retry opening saved data
              </Button>
              {status === "invalid" && (
                <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => setConfirmReset(true)}>
                  Reset saved data
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
            <ConfirmDialog
              open={confirmReset}
              onClose={() => setConfirmReset(false)}
              title="Reset saved data?"
              description="This permanently removes this browser's RoomieOS household, including chores, expenses and agreements. You will return to the sample or empty household choice."
              confirmLabel="Erase saved household"
              destructive
              onConfirm={() => {
                if (store.clear().ok) setConfirmReset(false);
              }}
            />
          </main>
        );
      }
      return (
        <>
          {conflict && (
            <div
              className="border-b border-warning bg-warning-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-warning"
              role="alert"
            >
              <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-[1120px] flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <p>

    "use client";
    
    import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
    import { X } from "lucide-react";
    import { Button } from "./button";
    import { InlineNotice } from "./inline-notice";
    
    type DialogProps = {
      open: boolean;
      onClose: () => void;
      title: string;
      description?: string;
      children: ReactNode;
      variant?: "modal" | "drawer";
      id?: string;
    };
    
    export function Dialog({
      open,
      onClose,
      title,
      description,
      children,
      variant = "modal",
      id,
    }: DialogProps) {
      const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
      const titleId = useId();
      const descriptionId = useId();
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const dialog = dialogRef.current;
        if (!dialog || !open) return;
        const trigger =
          document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
            ? document.activeElement
            : null;
        dialog.showModal();
        return () => {
          dialog.close();
          if (trigger?.isConnected) trigger.focus();
        };
      }, [open]);
    
      return (
        <dialog
          ref={dialogRef}
          id={id}
          aria-labelledby={titleId}
          aria-describedby={description ? descriptionId : undefined}
          onCancel={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            onClose();
          }}
          className={`fixed flex-col overflow-hidden border border-line bg-page p-0 text-ink shadow-xl ${variant === "drawer" ? "inset-y-0 left-0 m-0 h-dvh max-h-dvh w-80 max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] rounded-r-xl" : "inset-0 m-auto max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] w-[calc(100%-2rem)] max-w-lg rounded-xl"}`}
        >
          <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-line px-5 py-3">
            <h2 id={titleId} className="text-lg font-semibold">
              {title}
            </h2>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label={`Close ${title}`}
              title="Close"
              size="icon"
            >
              <X aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
          <div className="overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-5">
            {description && (
              <p id={descriptionId} className="mb-5 text-sm text-muted">
                {description}
              </p>
            )}
            {children}
          </div>
        </dialog>
      );
    }
    
    export function ConfirmDialog({
      open,
      onClose,
      onConfirm,
      title,
      description,
      confirmLabel,
      destructive = false,
      error,
    }: Omit<DialogProps, "children" | "variant" | "id"> & {
      onConfirm: () => void;
      confirmLabel: string;
      destructive?: boolean;
      error?: string;
    }) {
      return (
        <Dialog
          open={open}
          onClose={onClose}
          title={title}
          description={description}
        >
          {error && (
            <div className="mb-4">
              <InlineNotice tone="error">{error}</InlineNotice>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-3">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant={destructive ? "danger" : "primary"}
              onClick={onConfirm}
            >
              {confirmLabel}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Dialog>
      );
    }

    "use client";
    
    import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
    import { Plus, Settings } from "lucide-react";
    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { FormField } from "@/components/ui/form-field";
    import { Dialog, ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { MemberAvatar } from "@/components/ui/member-avatar";
    import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/page-header";
    import {
      activeMembers,
      archiveBlockReason,
      type MemberDraft,
    } from "@/domain/household";
    import { householdDraftSchema, memberDraftSchema } from "@/domain/validation";
    import { useReadyHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    import { AvatarField, CurrencyField, focusInvalid } from "./fields";
    import type { AppState, Member } from "@/domain/types";
    
    function HouseholdForm({ state }: { state: AppState }) {
      const { store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [name, setName] = useState(state.household.name);
      const [currency, setCurrency] = useState(state.household.currency);
      const [nameError, setNameError] = useState<string>();
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const result = householdDraftSchema.safeParse({
          name: name.trim(),
          currency,
        });
        if (!result.success) {
          setNameError("Enter a household name (1–60 characters).");
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        setNameError(undefined);
        const saved = store.dispatch(
          { type: "update-household", ...result.data },
          "Household saved.",
        );
        setSaveError(saved.ok ? undefined : saved.error);
      }
      return (
        <section className="border-t border-line py-7">
          <h2 className="mb-5 text-lg font-semibold">Household</h2>
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="max-w-xl space-y-5">
            <FormField
              id="settings-household-name"
              label="Household name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
              required
              maxLength={60}
              error={nameError}
            />
            <CurrencyField
              value={currency}
              onChange={setCurrency}
              disabled={state.expenses.length > 0}
            />
            {state.expenses.length > 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted">
                Currency is locked while any expenses exist, including settled
                expenses. Remove all expenses before changing it.
              </p>
            )}
            {saveError && <InlineNotice tone="error">{saveError}</InlineNotice>}
            <Button type="submit" disabled={conflict}>
              Save household
            </Button>
          </form>
        </section>
      );
    }
    
    function MemberEditor({
      member,
      onClose,
    }: {
      member: Member | null;
      onClose: () => void;
    }) {
      const { store, conflict } = useReadyHousehold();
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<MemberDraft>(
        member
          ? { name: member.name, avatar: member.avatar }
          : { name: "", avatar: { kind: "initials", value: "" } },
      );
      const [nameError, setNameError] = useState<string>();
      const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string>();
      const title = member ? "Edit roommate" : "Add roommate";
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const result = memberDraftSchema.safeParse({
          ...draft,
          name: draft.name.trim(),
        });
        if (!result.success) {
          setNameError("Enter a roommate name (1–40 characters).");
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        setNameError(undefined);
        const saved = store.dispatch(
          member
            ? { type: "edit-member", id: member.id, member: result.data }
            : { type: "add-member", member: result.data },
          member ? "Roommate updated." : "Roommate added.",
        );
        if (saved.ok) onClose();
        else setSaveError(saved.error);
      }
      return (
        <Dialog
          open
          onClose={onClose}
          title={title}
          description="This is a local demo profile, not a user account."
        >
          <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-5">
            <FormField
              id="member-name"
              label="Roommate name"
      focusInvalid,
    } from "@/features/household/fields";
    import { setupSchema } from "@/domain/validation";
    import type { Currency } from "@/domain/types";
    import type { MemberDraft } from "@/domain/household";
    import { useHousehold } from "@/state/household-provider";
    
    const newMember = (): MemberDraft => ({
      name: "",
      avatar: { kind: "initials", value: "" },
    });
    
    export function WelcomeScreen() {
      const { store, error, conflict } = useHousehold();
      const [mode, setMode] = useState<"sample" | "empty" | null>(null);
      const [name, setName] = useState("");
      const [currency, setCurrency] = useState<Currency>("CAD");
      const [members, setMembers] = useState([newMember(), newMember()]);
      const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
      const updateMember = (index: number, change: Partial<MemberDraft>) =>
        setMembers((rows) =>
          rows.map((member, i) =>
            i === index ? { ...member, ...change } : member,
          ),
        );
    
      function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!mode) return;
        store.dismissFeedback();
        if (mode === "sample") {
          store.sample(currency);
          return;
        }
        const input = {
          name: name.trim(),
          currency,
          members: members.map((member) => ({
            ...member,
            name: member.name.trim(),
          })),
        };
        const result = setupSchema.safeParse(input);
        if (!result.success) {
          setErrors(
            Object.fromEntries(
              result.error.issues.map((issue) => [
                issue.path.join("."),
                issue.path[0] === "name"
                  ? "Enter a household name (1–60 characters)."
                  : "Enter a roommate name (1–40 characters).",
              ]),
            ),
          );
          focusInvalid(event.currentTarget);
          return;
        }
        setErrors({});
        store.setup(result.data);
      }
    
      return (
        <main className="mx-auto flex min-h-dvh w-full max-w-3xl flex-col justify-center px-4 py-10 sm:px-8 sm:py-16">
          <div className="mb-10 self-start">
            <Wordmark />
          </div>
                            required
                            maxLength={40}
                            value={member.name}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                              updateMember(index, { name: event.target.value })
                            }
                            error={errors[`members.${index}.name`]}
                          />
                          <AvatarField
                            id={`roommate-${index}-avatar`}
                            label={`Roommate ${index + 1} avatar`}
                            avatar={member.avatar}
                            onChange={(avatar) => updateMember(index, { avatar })}
                          />
                        </div>
                        {members.length > 2 && (
                          <Button
                            size="icon"
                            variant="ghost"
                            className="mt-7"
                            aria-label={`Remove roommate ${index + 1}`}
                            onClick={() => {
                              setMembers((rows) =>
                                rows.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
                              );
                              setErrors({});
                            }}
                          >
                            <X aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
                          </Button>
                        )}

    # Household state boundary
    
    Milestone 2 adds a single client provider here, mounted above household routes so navigation preserves state. It owns validated `AppState` facts, typed commands and the `roomieos:v1` storage adapter. Feature components keep temporary form drafts locally. Domain functions remain independent of React and storage; selectors derive balances and counts.
    
    Milestone 1 deliberately does not read or write browser household storage. No provider or seed state is installed until validation and recovery are implemented together.
    # RoomieOS
    
    Your shared home, organized. An ENTI 407 client-side household prototype built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Lucide.
    
    ## Local development
    
    Use Node.js 22.12 or newer and npm:
    
    ```sh
    npm ci
    npm run dev
    ```
    
    Open <http://localhost:3000>. The current milestone includes the responsive app shell and informative foundation screens. Household setup, profile switching and local persistence are the next milestone; this version does not initialize or modify household storage.
    
    ## Checks
    
    ```sh
    npm run lint
    npm run typecheck
    npm test
    npm run build
    npm run test:browser
    ```
    
    Vitest is configured for future domain/storage tests; it currently permits an empty suite. Browser tests cover navigation, responsive overflow and native-dialog keyboard behavior at 375, 768 and 1280 px. Install Playwright Chromium once with `npx playwright install chromium`, or use an existing compatible Chromium executable:
    
    ```sh
    CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium-browser npm run test:browser
    ```
    
    The browser suite starts its own local dev server on port 3100 with an isolated `.next-e2e/` build directory, leaving a running preview on port 3000 alone. Override the test port with `ROOMIEOS_TEST_PORT` if necessary. Screenshots and failure traces are saved under the ignored `test-results/` directory.
    
    ## Hydration troubleshooting
    
    If the development overlay shows unexpected HTML attributes such as `bis_skin_checked` or `bis_register`, a browser extension may have modified the page before React hydrated it. Those attributes are not generated by RoomieOS. Try a fresh browser profile with extensions disabled, or a private window where no extensions are allowed. If the warning disappears, disable the responsible extension for localhost and reload. See the [Next.js hydration guide](https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/react-hydration-error).
    
    Keep hydration diagnostics enabled. The route browser test checks both uncaught errors and console errors, including React hydration warnings, in an isolated browser context. If the warning persists with extensions disabled, inspect the new diff for an application mismatch.
    
    ## Structure and deployment
    
    - `src/app`: static App Router pages and household route-group layout.
    - `src/components`: shared shell and UI primitives.
    - `src/features`: feature views; foundation views will be replaced incrementally.
    - `src/domain`: serializable types and, in later milestones, pure domain utilities.
    - `src/state`: reserved boundary for the household provider and storage adapter.
    - `src/styles`: design tokens mapped into Tailwind.
    
    `npm run build` exports static files to `out/`, suitable for Vercel. There are no backend API routes, server mutations, remote fonts or service integrations. No deployment is performed by the foundation scripts.
    
    Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), [PLAN.md](PLAN.md), [PRD](docs/PRD.md) and [DESIGN](docs/DESIGN.md) before implementation. PLAN tracks verified progress; PRD and DESIGN remain authoritative for behavior and UI/UX.

    # RoomieOS — Codex repository instructions
    
    ## Mission and source of truth
    
    Build **RoomieOS**, a polished, accessible **client-side prototype** for university students living with roommates. The app coordinates chores, shared expenses and household agreements. It is an ENTI 407 Creation Project with a Friday, 27 November 2026 deadline.
    
    Read the relevant sections of:
    - `docs/PRD.md` — product requirements, decisions, invariants and acceptance criteria. **Authoritative for behavior.**
    - `docs/DESIGN.md` — visual language, navigation, components and responsive behavior. **Authoritative for UI/UX.**
    - `PLAN.md` — approved architecture, implementation milestones, decisions and verification progress. **Authoritative for sequencing and progress.**
    
    These files contain the agreed decisions. Don't redesign features based on assumptions, or rewrite these documents unless the user explicitly asks. For a small scoped change, consult only the relevant sections rather than repeatedly reading every line.
    
    Read `PLAN.md` before implementation. Follow its approved milestones and update progress, actual verification results, blockers and approved decisions after each working slice. `docs/PRD.md` remains authoritative for behavior and `docs/DESIGN.md` for UI/UX; `PLAN.md` governs sequencing and progress. Surface conflicts rather than inventing requirements or silently expanding scope. Do not mark unchecked behavior as verified. Routine progress updates to `PLAN.md` are expected; changes to approved scope or decisions require user approval.
    
    ## Hard scope constraints
    
    - Stack: **Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Lucide icons (`lucide-react`)**; deploy on **Vercel**.
    - Persist a single versioned household in **browser `localStorage`**, key `roomieos:v1`.
    - **No backend, database service, authentication, user accounts, cloud storage, WebSockets, API keys, third-party AI, analytics or network integrations.**
    - **No fake collaboration.** A profile switcher represents a *local demo perspective*, not a real authenticated roommate.
    - **No actual money transfers.** Expense settlement is a manual whole-expense marker; don't imply an integrated payment system.
    - One household; **2–5 active roommates**. First-run must explicitly offer **sample household** or **empty household setup**.
    - Essential screens: Dashboard, Chores (List + Kanban), Expenses, Agreements, Settings, and first-run Welcome.
    - Household currency (CAD, USD, EUR, GBP) is chosen by the user; no exchange-rate calculation. Block currency changes while any expenses exist.
    - No activity feed, scheduled/background jobs, push notifications, drag-and-drop dependency, or additional features beyond PRD without approval.
    
    ## Rules that must not be broken
    
    1. **Do all expense arithmetic in integer cents.** Payer contributions and participant shares must separately sum exactly to total. Never use floating-point totals for stored financial amounts.
    2. Support **multiple payers** and all three participant split modes: equal, percentage, fixed. Use deterministic cent-allocation and validate every form.
    3. Only **open** expenses contribute to member net balances. `memberNet = totalPaid - totalShare`. Sum of nets must be zero. Debt simplification should preserve amounts and avoid invented payments.
    4. **Settling an expense means fully resolved outside the app**, excludes its net from outstanding balances, retains the record, and can be undone.
    5. Chore states are **pending, completed, skipped**. Completing writes an immutable completion event containing who and when; reopening/rotation doesn't delete history.
    6. Manual chore rotation walks the **stable active roommate roster order**, wraps around, reopens the chore as Pending and asks/confirms a new due date.
    7. Archive an active roommate only if >=2 active remain and the member has **no pending assigned chores or unsettled expense participation/contribution**. Historical records keep member identity; archived members are excluded from new selections.
    8. Every important change persists after refresh in the same browser. Refresh must not overwrite a visitor's modifications with seed data.
    9. Handle invalid input and storage failure gracefully; never silently corrupt saved state.
    10. Do not introduce dead buttons, placeholder interactions, fabricated dashboard statistics, or UI claims that contradict the local-only prototype.
    
    ## Implementation approach
    
    - Favor a clear structure (pages/features/components/domain utilities/state) over unnecessary layers, abstractions or frameworks.
    - Use typed, serializable state with `schemaVersion: 1`. Validate data on load and recover with a user-visible choice if the stored payload is invalid.
    - Put financial splitting, netting and chore rotation in **pure functions**; keep UI components thin.
    - Keep a single source of truth for the household state. Derived totals, balances and dashboard counts must be calculated from state, not persisted redundantly.
    - Use semantic HTML, accessible labeled forms and keyboard-operable dialogs. Maintain desktop and mobile usability.
    - Prefer reuse of a small set of components: app shell, member avatar/picker, modal, forms, status pill, table/cards, empty state.
    - Seed realistic *valid* demo data only when selected or reset. Use relative dates to keep overdue examples meaningful.
    - Avatar upload is optional and lower priority; initials/icons must always work without uploads or remote image URLs.
    - Avoid dependencies that are not justified for a four-day prototype.
    
    ## Workflow when implementing a task
    
    1. Identify the requested feature and consult the relevant PRD/DESIGN sections. **If the user says plan only, do not modify files.**
    2. Briefly state the intended files/behavior when the change is substantial; implement a narrow, testable slice.
    3. Test the change: run available project scripts (`npm run build`, tests, lint/typecheck if configured). Don't claim commands ran unless they actually ran.
    4. For expense math, test cent rounding, multiple payers, custom percentage/fixed splits, zero-sum nets, settlement/reopen and invalid totals.
    5. For chores, test completion history, rotation wraparound, archived members and overdue date comparisons.
    6. Manually outline UI checks the user should perform (especially refresh, empty state, Kanban, and mobile).
    7. Report succinctly: what changed, test results, known limitations, and the next suitable slice. If blocked, explain precisely.
    8. Preserve working functionality. Make small focused edits; do not casually rewrite unrelated modules.
    
    ## Suggested delivery order
    
    1. Project scaffold, visual shell, welcome sample/empty setup, household roster, local persistence.
    2. Chores CRUD, status/history, rotation, list/Kanban, overdue.
    3. Expenses CRUD, all contribution/split modes, cents math, simplified balances and settlement.
    4. Dashboard integration, agreements, settings, confirmations and reset.
    5. Responsive/accessibility polish, build/test verification, deploy.
    
    The PRD's must-have correctness and course deliverables outrank optional styling extras. Prioritize a usable, complete app by Thursday, leaving Friday as a buffer.
    
    ## Git and submission hygiene
    
    - Keep changes reviewable. Prefer commits at working milestones; **do not run destructive Git commands or overwrite user changes** without permission.
    - Never commit secrets, credentials or irrelevant personal data. No secrets are required by this project.
    - The course requests **the complete dated conversation with the AI builder** as a prompt log. Do **not** fabricate, summarize in place of, or retroactively invent prompts or dates. The user should export/save the **real Codex session transcript** from their Codex environment and review it before submission. `docs/PRD.md` and `docs/DESIGN.md` may accompany the log as appendices.
    - A passing build isn't proof of perfect UX: make it easy to verify functionality manually in a browser.

    # RoomieOS implementation plan
    
    **Last updated:** 23 November 2026
    
    **Status:** Milestone 2 implemented and verified locally; no deployment performed.
    
    **Current milestone:** Milestone 2 — setup and local persistence complete.
    
    **Next milestone:** Milestone 3 — chore CRUD, history, rotation and List/Kanban.
    
    **Delivery target:** Thursday, 26 November 2026; Friday, 27 November is the submission/fix buffer.
    
    ## 1. Purpose, authority and decisions
    
    Build a polished Next.js client-side prototype for ENTI 407. `docs/PRD.md` is authoritative for behavior; `docs/DESIGN.md` is authoritative for UI/UX. This document records approved architecture, sequencing and actual progress. It does not override those requirements.
    
    At plan approval, the repository contained documentation and a README, with no application scaffold. The foundation and household setup/persistence are now implemented; see the progress record below. Update this record after each working slice: check only completed work, record actual verification, and keep the current/next milestone accurate. Surface conflicts or new scope for user review rather than inventing requirements.
    
    ### Resolved requirements and defaults
    
    - **Backend conflict resolved:** The user selected the approved local-only scope. Use Next.js App Router without backend API routes, Server Actions, authentication or a database. Household operations run in the browser.
    - **History ordering:** Preserve completion events in append order; display newest first, as DESIGN specifies.
    - **Archived-member edge cases:** Historical records remain viewable and editable without losing member references. Before reopening an expense involving archived members, require their restoration. Before reopening a chore assigned to an archived member, require reassignment to an active member. Rotation can directly select the next active member.
    - **Design contrast:** Preserve the visual palette, but use sufficiently dark text variants where muted tokens fail contrast requirements.
    - **Priority:** All PRD must-haves remain MVP requirements. Defer photo uploads, drag-and-drop and decorative animation.
    
    ## 2. Architecture and state
    
    Use Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and `lucide-react`, with static deployment on Vercel.
    
    ### Application structure
    
    - **Routes (`src/app`):** `/` for Dashboard, plus `/welcome`, `/chores`, `/expenses`, `/agreements` and `/settings`. A client initialization gate shows loading until storage is read, then presents setup, recovery or the requested screen.
    - **Shared UI (`src/components`, `src/styles`):** App shell, page header, avatar/picker, fields, status pills, accessible dialogs, confirmations, notices and empty states. Desktop sidebar; mobile navigation drawer. Tables become cards on phones; Kanban scrolls within its own region.
    - **Feature modules (`src/features`):** Setup, household, chores, expenses, agreements and dashboard. Keep form drafts local to their feature.
    - **Domain utilities (`src/domain`):** Types, runtime validation, money parsing/allocation, balances, rotation, date helpers and sample generation. These functions must not depend on React or browser storage.
    - **State layer (`src/state`):** One client provider with typed domain actions and shared selectors. Route changes must preserve the provider. Keep browser storage access behind a small adapter.
    
    Follow the PRD's `AppState` model with `schemaVersion: 1`. Use stable IDs and member ordering; retain archived members. Persist facts, selected profile and settings. Calculate balances, transfer suggestions, overdue indicators and dashboard counts from those facts.
    
    ### Important interfaces
    
    - Domain actions cover CRUD, status changes, rotation, archive/restore, profile selection and resets.
    - Commands return success or actionable validation/storage errors.
    - Storage exposes load, save and clear operations with explicit failure results.
    - Inject time and ID generation into domain operations where needed for deterministic tests.
    
    ### Financial rules
    
    - Parse currency input as decimal strings into integer cents; percentages into integer basis points.
    - Require safe integer amounts and reject inputs whose calculations exceed supported integer bounds.
    - Allocate equal-split remainder cents by stable roster order. Use largest remainder for percentages, with the same stable tie-breaker.
    - Validate payer and participant totals independently. Reject duplicate entries for the same member within each role.
    - Generate advisory transfers from open-expense nets, matching largest balances first with stable member-ID ties.
    - Settlement is a confirmed whole-expense marker for resolution outside the app, never an integrated payment action.
    
    ## 3. Persistence and recovery
    
    Use only `localStorage["roomieos:v1"]`.
    
    - Read storage once after client mount. Do not render household-dependent content or save defaults before initialization completes.
    - Distinguish absent data, valid data, malformed/unsupported data and unavailable storage.
    - Validate structure, references, roster constraints, dates and financial invariants on load and before persistence.
    - Generate sample data only after explicit selection or confirmed reset. Base dates on the local date at that moment.
    - For each change, calculate and validate the next state, persist it, then publish it to React. Show success only after saving succeeds.
    - If saving fails, preserve the prior household and the user's form input. Show a useful error and allow retry.
    - Invalid data remains untouched until the user confirms reset. Unsupported versions must not silently become sample data.
    - Reset demo replaces saved state only after confirmation. Start over clears it only after confirmation and successful storage removal.
    - On another tab's storage change, stop stale writes and offer reload before further editing.
    - Store calendar dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`; use timestamps for completion events. Recompute date-sensitive displays on focus and relevant interactions.
    
    ## 4. Milestones and implementation order
    
    Each milestone ends with relevant checks, a reviewable commit and a progress update here. Introduce polish with each feature rather than postponing the entire visual design until release. During intermediate milestones, hide unavailable actions instead of exposing dead buttons.
    
    | Done | Milestone | Deliverable and acceptance gate | Target |

    | [ ] | 6. Release | Accessibility/mobile checks, production build, Vercel verification, video and real prompt transcript | Thursday |

    ## 5. Dependencies, tests and risks
    
    ### Dependencies
    
    Next.js, React, React DOM, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Lucide. Add Zod for runtime validation and Vitest for domain/storage tests. Use native forms and native dialogs with tested focus handling. Avoid state libraries, chart packages, remote fonts and UI frameworks. Select compatible stable package versions during scaffolding and commit the lockfile.

TypeScript is pinned to 6.0.3 because the installed Next.js lint tooling rejects TypeScript 7; ESLint 9 matches the upstream React plugin's supported peer range. Exact dependency versions are recorded in `package-lock.json`.
    
    ### Required verification
    
    - **Money:** 100 cents across three participants yields 34/33/33; multiple payers; percentage rounding/ties; fixed totals; invalid inputs; zero-sum nets; deterministic transfers; settlement/reopening.
    - **Chores:** Completion identity/time; repeated completion without duplicate events for unchanged status; preserved history; rotation wraparound and archived members; yesterday/today comparisons.
    - **State/storage:** Sample and empty initialization; malformed/unsupported payloads; failed reads/writes/clears; roster limits; archive guards; currency blocked by any expenses.
    - **Browser:** Refresh every major flow, switch perspective, cancel dialogs, keyboard navigation/focus restoration, error feedback and every visible action.
    - **Layout:** 375, 768 and 1280 px; contained board scrolling; usable expense forms and dialogs.
    - **Release:** Lint, typecheck, tests and production build; deployed deep links and private-window first-run behavior.
    
    ### Main risks and mitigations
    
    | Risk | Mitigation |
    |---|---|
    | Expense-form complexity and rounding | Implement pure tested arithmetic first; preview exact contributions/shares before save |
    | Storage hydration and data loss | Client initialization gate, runtime validation, explicit recovery and save-before-publish |
    | Archived historical references | Retain member records and stable order; guard reopening and new assignments |
    | Dialog accessibility and mobile density | Reuse shared primitives; check keyboard, focus and small viewports early |
    | Short deadline | Small milestones; prioritize correct required behavior; defer optional visuals/uploads |

      setupSchema,
      validateState,
    } from "./validation";
    import type { AppState, Currency, Member } from "./types";
    
    export type MemberDraft = Pick<Member, "name" | "avatar">;
    export type SetupInput = {
      name: string;
      currency: Currency;
      members: MemberDraft[];
    };
    export type HouseholdAction =
      | { type: "update-household"; name: string; currency: Currency }
      | { type: "add-member"; member: MemberDraft }
      | { type: "edit-member"; id: string; member: MemberDraft }
      | { type: "archive-member"; id: string }
      | { type: "restore-member"; id: string }
      | { type: "select-member"; id: string };
    
    export function activeMembers(state: AppState): Member[] {
      return state.members
        .filter((member) => member.active)
        .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
    }
    
    export function archiveBlockReason(state: AppState, id: string): string | null {
      if (activeMembers(state).length <= 2)
        return "At least two active roommates must remain.";
      const chores = state.chores.some(
        (chore) => chore.assigneeId === id && chore.status === "pending",
      );
      const expenses = state.expenses.some(
        (expense) =>
          expense.status === "open" &&
          [...expense.payers, ...expense.participants].some(
            (row) => row.memberId === id,
          ),
      );
      if (chores && expenses)
        return "Reassign this roommate's pending chores and settle their open expenses first.";
      if (chores) return "Reassign this roommate's pending chores first.";
      if (expenses) return "Settle this roommate's open expenses first.";
      return null;
    }
    
    export function createEmptyHousehold(
      input: SetupInput,
      makeId: () => string,
    ): AppState {
      const clean = setupSchema.parse({
        ...input,
        name: input.name.trim(),
        members: input.members.map((member) => ({
          ...member,
          name: member.name.trim(),
        })),
      });
      const members = clean.members.map((member, order) => ({
        ...member,
        id: makeId(),
        active: true,
        order,
      }));
      return validateState({
        schemaVersion: 1,
        household: { name: clean.name, currency: clean.currency },
        members,
        selectedMemberId: members[0].id,
        chores: [],
        expenses: [],
        agreements: [],
        starterMode: "empty",
      });
    }
    
    export function applyHouseholdAction(
      state: AppState,
      action: HouseholdAction,
      makeId: () => string,
    ): AppState {
      let next: AppState;
      if (action.type === "update-household") {
        const household = householdDraftSchema.parse({
          name: action.name.trim(),
          currency: action.currency,
        });
        if (
          household.currency !== state.household.currency &&
          state.expenses.length > 0
        )
          throw new Error(
            "Remove all expenses, including settled expenses, before changing currency.",
          );
        next = { ...state, household };
      } else if (action.type === "add-member") {
        if (activeMembers(state).length >= 5)
          throw new Error("A household can have at most five active roommates.");
        const member = memberDraftSchema.parse({
          ...action.member,
          name: action.member.name.trim(),
        });
        next = {
          ...state,
          members: [
            ...state.members,
            {
              ...member,
              id: makeId(),
              active: true,
              order: Math.max(...state.members.map((item) => item.order)) + 1,
            },
          ],
        };
      } else {
        const member = state.members.find((item) => item.id === action.id);
        if (!member)
          throw new Error(
            "This roommate could not be found. Reload the household and try again.",
          );
        if (action.type === "select-member") {
          if (!member.active) throw new Error("Choose an active roommate.");
          next = { ...state, selectedMemberId: member.id };
        } else if (action.type === "edit-member") {
          const changes = memberDraftSchema.parse({
            ...action.member,
            name: action.member.name.trim(),
          });
          next = {
            ...state,
            members: state.members.map((item) =>
              item.id === member.id ? { ...item, ...changes } : item,
            ),
          };
        } else {
          const active = action.type === "restore-member";
          if (member.active === active) return state;
          if (active && activeMembers(state).length >= 5)
            throw new Error(
              "Archive another roommate before restoring this one. The active limit is five.",
            );
          if (!active) {

    test("roster editing, limits, archive fallback and restore retain stable identities", async ({

      await createEmpty(page);

      ).toBeDisabled();
      await addMember(page, "Taylor");
      const original = (await saved(page))!;
      const taylor = original.members.find((member) => member.name === "Taylor")!;
      await page.getByLabel("Switch demo perspective").selectOption(taylor.id);
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Archive Taylor", exact: true })
        .click();
      let dialog = page.getByRole("dialog", {
        name: "Archive Taylor?",
        exact: true,
      });
      await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel", exact: true }).click();
      expect(
        (await saved(page))!.members.find((member) => member.id === taylor.id)!
          .active,
      ).toBe(true);
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Archive Taylor", exact: true })
        .click();
      dialog = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Archive Taylor?", exact: true });
      await dialog
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Archive roommate", exact: true })
        .click();
      await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByLabel("Switch demo perspective")).toHaveValue(
        original.members[0].id,
      );
      await page.reload();
      await expect(
        page
          .getByRole("list", { name: "Archived roommates" })
          .getByRole("button", { name: "Restore Taylor", exact: true }),
      ).toBeVisible();
      await page
        .getByRole("button", { name: "Restore Taylor", exact: true })
        .click();
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Edit Taylor", exact: true }).click();
      const editor = page.getByRole("dialog", {
        name: "Edit roommate",
        exact: true,
      });
      await editor.getByLabel("Roommate name").fill("Taylor Lee");
      await editor.getByLabel("Avatar", { exact: true }).selectOption("☀️");
      await editor.getByRole("button", { name: "Save roommate" }).click();
      await expect(editor).not.toBeVisible();
      await addMember(page, "Riley");
      await addMember(page, "Casey");
      await expect(
        page.getByRole("button", { name: "Add roommate", exact: true }),
      ).toBeDisabled();
      await page.screenshot({
        path: testInfo.outputPath("settings.png"),
        fullPage: true,
      });
      await page.reload();
      const restored = (await saved(page))!;
      expect(restored.members.find((member) => member.id === taylor.id)).toEqual({
        ...taylor,
        name: "Taylor Lee",
        avatar: { kind: "icon", value: "☀️" },
      });
      expect(restored.members.map((member) => member.order)).toEqual([
        0, 1, 2, 3, 4,
      ]);
      expect(
        await page.evaluate(
          () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth,
        ),
      ).toBe(false);
    });

    "use client";
    
    import { SelectField } from "@/components/ui/select-field";
    import { avatarIcons, currencies } from "@/domain/validation";
    import type { Currency, Member } from "@/domain/types";
    
    export function CurrencyField({
      value,
      onChange,
      disabled = false,
      id = "currency",
    }: {
      value: Currency;
      onChange: (value: Currency) => void;
      disabled?: boolean;
      id?: string;
    }) {
      return (
        <SelectField
          id={id}
          label="Household currency"
          value={value}
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value as Currency)}
        >
          {currencies.map((currency) => (
            <option key={currency} value={currency}>
              {currency}
            </option>
          ))}
        </SelectField>
      );
    }
    
    export function AvatarField({
      id,
      label = "Avatar",
      avatar,
      onChange,
    }: {
      id: string;
      label?: string;
      avatar: Member["avatar"];
      onChange: (avatar: Member["avatar"]) => void;
    }) {
      return (
        <SelectField
          id={id}
          label={label}
          value={avatar.kind === "icon" ? avatar.value : "initials"}
          onChange={(event) =>
            onChange(
              event.target.value === "initials"
                ? { kind: "initials", value: "" }
                : { kind: "icon", value: event.target.value },
            )
          }
        >
          <option value="initials">Initials</option>
          {avatarIcons.map((icon) => (
            <option key={icon} value={icon}>
              {icon}
            </option>
          ))}
        </SelectField>
      );
    }
    
    export function focusInvalid(form: HTMLFormElement) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() =>
        form.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-invalid="true"]')?.focus(),
      );
    }
    import { UserRound } from "lucide-react";
    
    export function MemberAvatar({
      name,
      icon,
      size = "sm",
    }: {
      name: string;
      icon?: string;
      size?: "sm" | "md";
    }) {
      const initials = name
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/u)
        .slice(0, 2)
        .map((part) => Array.from(part)[0] ?? "")
        .join("")
        .toLocaleUpperCase();
      return (
        <span
          role="img"
          aria-label={name || "Roommate"}
          className={`inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-subtle font-semibold text-muted ${size === "sm" ? "size-8 text-xs" : "size-11 text-sm"}`}
        >
          <span aria-hidden="true">
            {icon || initials || <UserRound className="size-4" />}
          </span>
        </span>
      );
    }

    import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    import { FormField } from "@/components/ui/form-field";
    import { InlineNotice } from "@/components/ui/inline-notice";
    import { MemberAvatar } from "@/components/ui/member-avatar";
    import { Wordmark } from "@/components/wordmark";
    import {
      AvatarField,
      CurrencyField,
